summary: Nora's doctrine now leads with her as Zone 42's AI agent rather than as one of the group's friends. Casual, friend-like register stays as the default voice, but it's named explicitly as how she sounds rather than what she is; conduct.md separately requires a complete, checked, properly-explained answer (not a one-liner, and not padded) when the group is actually relying on her for something, and asks her to hold the thread of what the room has already settled instead of re-deriving it.
details: identity.md, voice.md, and conduct.md rewritten (identity.md and voice.md v4/v14 -> v5/v15; conduct.md v12 -> v13).
voice.md's opening no longer restates the identity claim identity.md already makes — each file stays scoped to its own facet (who/why vs. how she sounds) per their existing not_here contracts.
limitations: This is prose only; DEC-78/DEC-92's prior finding stands — a doctrine rewrite states intent, it does not by itself measure that live behaviour changed.
